description: Readback-verified FL Studio transport, mixer, channel, sequencer, and plug-in control.
name: io.github.synopsys0/postfader-fl-studio-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to build the MIDI SysEx transport. Without it the server cannot reach FL Studio.
environmentVariables.name: FL_BRIDGE_ENABLE_MIDI

environmentVariables.description: Exact virtual MIDI endpoint name shared with FL Studio. Postfader does not install or configure a virtual MIDI provider.
environmentVariables.name: FL_BRIDGE_MIDI_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Absolute FL Studio user-data directory containing Settings/Hardware.
environmentVariables.name: FL_STUDIO_USER_DATA_DIR

title: Postfader
